folds.heading: ## Catalogue-use reconciliation B133, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Full catalogue1–34/Q1–Q23/owner recommendations/C1–C10/G1–G15/open questions read. Preserve family diversity, source versus design, original/public variants, dependent-world mechanisms and quoted versus paraphrased direction. Its counts describe different dates/overlapping tables, not a current unique cheat census. The original source grep cannot sustain today’s no-card/no-heir/no-hook/no-across-life claims; B132 separately inspects current named code. B124’s original stand-ins likewise qualify blanket no original-body examples, without certifying every family. No full source-world or underlying authority-locator review is granted by reading this catalogue.

C3 remains a real owner contradiction: [CHEAT_COSMOLOGY](../../../CHEAT_COSMOLOGY.md#the-key-to-portability-what-backs-a-cheat) says knowledge always travels, while its later bullet and [accepted Rulebook5](../../../RULES_FROM_SCRATCH.md#the-rulebook-accepted-2026-10-10) require an actual carrier. B133 directly fixes that cell; the original/updated text is retained in the ledger. This is a standing-rule reconciliation, not a new product decision. C1 distinguishes exactly-once settlement from lifetime lore limits. C4 permits genuinely no-cost means, and C6 permits an actually exact reader; readings can be wrong does not force every diagnosis wrong. Both winner modes remain world-specific, neither a universal tier trump. Unknowns remain supported rather than forced either/or questions.

C7’s suggested sealed field is unselected schema design, not a necessary/sufficient secrecy proof. Actual producers, means, knowledge projection, normal metadata and report routes matter. Missing a field name alone neither proves a leak nor authorizes schema expansion. All current secret handling uses IDs/routes/status outside discovery. Proposed owner moves/pointers retain their rationale; no body of useful source/history was deleted or relocated. Current [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md), AD32/AD42/AD51 in [rules index](../../../RULES_INDEX.md) and current source owners govern order, optional review and reasonable shared design. Old first-slice/heir/no-canon-condition questions are not new permission gates. Remaining C/G rows require actual selected-owner review before being called resolved.

folds.heading: ## Knowledge-carrier reconciliation B133, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The complete [ReaderB catalogue](audits/cheat-implementation-2026-10-10/readers/B_doc_catalog.md#catalogue-use-reconciliation-b133-2026-11-04) identified C3; selected actual text confirmed the backing table still said “Always travels” despite the later carrier bullet. The Knowledge row now follows [Rulebook5](RULES_FROM_SCRATCH.md#the-rulebook-accepted-2026-10-10): knowledge crosses through an actual carrier and its world/cheat rules, rather than an unconditional memory guarantee. Existing relevance/accuracy decay remains possible. Exact old/new wording is retained in [B133](audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/content-b133.json).

This corrects one row, not every backing example or every cross-world memory, soul, record or body operation. The October10 both-winner record remains intact; no universal tier winner is imposed. A palette title, catalogue family or display label does not transmit actual knowledge, mastery, fuel, office or obligations. No new carrier power, migration or runtime behavior was introduced. Only selected34–82/120–136/468–475 of this owner were reviewed; the remaining body still needs independent coverage.
